author: benchriswii
body:
So Recently I have been building huge staircases on the map quintus whenever I go on it and some people started helping me in my efforts. This team or group is dedicated to building stairs or skybridges on maps and quintus in particular. if you would like to join go ahead and ask there are no requirements so go ahead and join. I dont expect this to get very big but well its worth a shot so yeah.

REMEMBER THIS IS FOR PEOPLE WHO LIKE TO BUILD STAIRCASES OR SKYBRIDGES!!!
OUR TEAM WILL BE CALLED NSBBU.

benchriswii
